The dependency upgrade from `google-api-services-translate:v2` to `v3` required updating all code that references the API model classes, since V3 has a completely different class structure.

1. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/Language.java`**
   - Changed import: `LanguagesResource` → `SupportedLanguage`
   - Updated field mapping: `getLanguage()` → `getLanguageCode()`, `getName()` → `getDisplayName()`

2. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/Detection.java`**
   - Changed import: `DetectionsResourceItems` → `DetectedLanguage`
   - Updated field mapping: `getLanguage()` → `getLanguageCode()`

3. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/Translation.java`**
   - Changed import to use fully qualified name `com.google.api.services.translate.v3.model.Translation` (to avoid conflict with the local class)
   - Updated field mapping: `getDetectedSourceLanguage()` → `getDetectedLanguageCode()`

4. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/spi/v2/TranslateRpc.java`**
   - Updated interface method signatures to use V3 model classes
   - `detect()` now returns `List<DetectedLanguage>` instead of `List<List<DetectionsResourceItems>>`

5. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/spi/v2/HttpTranslateRpc.java`**
   - Updated to use V3 API methods: `projects().detectLanguage()`, `projects().getSupportedLanguages()`, `projects().translateText()`
   - Changed request/response handling to use V3 request objects (`DetectLanguageRequest`, `TranslateTextRequest`)

6. **`java-translate/google-cloud-translate/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/translate/TranslateImpl.java`**
